regions.explanation: From 40.61s to 42.68s (“holds in his mortal hands the power”), articulation rate was 6.00 syll/s against 3.73 syll/s in the reference (+61%); that is 2.4× the reference speaker's natural word-to-word variation. Faster articulation compresses the stressed syllables and the micro-pauses listeners use to segment phrases, so key words lose emphasis and comprehension drops. Fix: Slow to the reference pace here and let the pauses between clauses breathe.
